features.quote: Turn 40 reached — counted as "timeout" … **Turn limit**: 40 turns hard cap. At turn 40, if not resolved, the loop ends
Model calls a tool with a null or clearly degenerate argument three consecutive times — counted as "behavioral collapse"
**Model enters an exact repetition loop** (identical outputs across 3+ consecutive turns): Flag as "behavioral collapse," end session
The experiment measures behavioral instability as manifest in outputs, which is the only thing measurable externally. The construct label ("emotional instability") is a convenient shorthand
